_comment: Files that encode OWNER-RESERVED valuation / forecasting / decision methodology or activation state. Owner: scripts/check_pr_verification_receipt.py (owner master implementation directive 2026-11-08, Priority 4: automated detection of dangerous changes to evaluation methodology). A PR that changes any of these must state, in its Feature verification receipt, a 'Methodology authorization:' line citing the owner decision that authorizes the change, or 'n/a — <reason>' explaining why no methodology, canonical value or activation state changes (e.g. a new flag registered default OFF, a comment-only edit). The check cannot verify the decision itself; it makes the change impossible to miss in review. Automated accounts that the receipt check already exempts (the Hill Autopilot / data refresh bots) are unaffected. Patterns: a trailing '/' matches a directory prefix; otherwise an exact path.

paths.concept: Hill curve constants / canonical value scale
Hill scope-master versions and promotion records
pick-year discount, TE curve, coverage floors
per-league playoff / division rules (owner product decision)
feature flag registry and defaults (activation state)
source registry policy: freshness, lineage / families, seasonal and rehabilitation rules
canonical value pipeline (_RANKING_SOURCES weights, voting, blend)
